etymologies.etymologyHTML: From French optimisme, equivalent to Latin optimus +‎ -ism.

definitions.definition: a tendency to expect the best, or at least, a favourable outcome

quote.citation: 2021 February 9, Christina Newland, “Is Tom Hanks part of a dying breed of genuine movie stars?”, in BBC‎[1]:
quote.text: Hanks is known as being an avid reader of history and biography, and seems to seek out stories which offer a certain optimism and humanism. In other words, he plays – fundamentally – good people.

definitions.definition: the doctrine that this world is the best of all possible worlds
the belief that good will eventually triumph over evil
